fields.label: Collection ID
fields.help: The ID of the parent Collection.

fields.label: Data
fields.help: The JSON data of the DataObject.

fields.label: Data Object ID
fields.help: ID of the DataObject to create.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Etag
fields.help: The etag of the DataObject, used for optimistic concurrency control on updates and deletes.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.label: Vectors
fields.help: The vectors of the DataObject, keyed by the vector field name as defined in the parent Collection's 'vector_schema'.
